Selling Guide · 2026-11-04 · 4 min read

How Is the Price of Your Gold Calculated?

Every legitimate gold purchase in India uses the same basic formula. Once you know it, you can check any buyer's calculation on your phone.

The formula

Payout = item weight × purity % × today's live rate per gram of pure gold. A 22K piece is 91.6% pure (BIS 916 hallmark), 18K is 75%, and 14K is 58.5%. So a 10 g, 22K chain contains 9.16 g of pure gold — and is paid as 9.16 g at the live rate.

Where the live rate comes from

The rate follows the international gold price, converted at the day's rupee–dollar rate, plus local market factors. It changes daily — sometimes intraday — which is why honest buyers quote it at the counter.

What can legitimately reduce the figure

Stones and non-gold parts are not paid as gold (their weight isn't gold), and heavily alloyed or plated items test at lower purity. What should never appear is an unexplained percentage cut. If a buyer can't show you weight, purity and rate separately, the number is not verifiable.
